name: @levonis/platform-kit
description: The platform kit every LEVONIS Worker is built on: structured logging with correlation ids, UUIDv7 correlation, Ed25519 principals and hop envelopes (WebCrypto), the RPC client (budget, retry-on-idempotent, circuit breaker), fetchWithBudget, the owned-tables D1 guard, inList chunking, the transactional outbox and the RpcFanoutBus/QueueBus dispatchers, defineConsumer with processed_events idempotency, the idempotency store, config/feature-flag readers, rate-limiter adapters, the audit() facade, health, sagas, admin scope, realtime and process adapters, and byte-identical copies of the core's edge libraries (hosts, securityPolicy, middleware) plus gatewayOnly().
